adjudication.rationale: The finding correctly identifies that in app/views/embed/loading.html.erb, there's an unconditional setTimeout that reloads the page every 30 seconds. Looking at the embed_controller.rb, when TopicEmbed.topic_id_for_embed returns nil, it enqueues a RetrieveTopic job and renders 'loading'. If the retrieval fails (e.g., invalid URL, network error, or the source site is down), the topic_id will remain nil, and each reload will re-enqueue the job and show loading again indefinitely. There's no mechanism to detect or handle permanent failures, leading to infinite reload loops and repeated job enqueueing.
